incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — Dedicated capacity saturation in eu-west-2. p99 latency > 2.0s for 6m, queue depth rising. Stream stalls reported. thread root=5182024064
incident-bot: Current signals: p95=480ms, p99=2.3s, in-flight queue=12k, warmup_failures=14. Affected route: /v1/generate (dedicated-eu-west-2, model: redwood-ggml-7b).
oscar (eng-sre): i'm taking primary. i'm seeing autoscaler requests stuck in handshake phase — scale intents issued but slot warmups stuck at ~30s each. Logs: `handshake timeout` repeated. Opening metrics: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/5182024064
priya (eng-runtime): confirmed. pool-manager shows backlog in the `warmup` queue and a spike in `kv-cache` cold-path misses. Seems like sudden burst of small streaming requests — continuous batching is backpressuring. Warmup worker concurrency default=2; considering bump to 6.
oscar (eng-sre): quick triage: can we force-provision temporary capacity? if so we should also ensure warmup completes before routing.
matt (eng-platform): i can hot-provision 2 nodes from the reserved pool but warmup still needed. Command i ran: `allocctl provision --region eu-west-2 --pool dedicated-eu-west-2 --count 2` — waiting on cloud-side allocation (eta ~40s).
priya (eng-runtime): while nodes provision, we can enable immediate fallback routing (to hosted low-cost variant) for non-enterprise customers to reduce pressure. patch to routing layer: `routectl set-fallback /v1/generate hosted-medium --threshold 2000` — will start draining queue for non-SLA traffic.
danielle (oncall): i'm 2nd-oncall; taking watch. i'll start customer-impact triage. @nisha can you pull CS tickets to see who is hitting this right now?
nisha (support): on it. customer-success flagged 3 accounts showing degraded streaming and high token latencies. IDs: CNT-2134, CNT-7189, CNT-9001. CS contacting enterprise leads. ETA updates in #customer-updates channel.
priya (eng-runtime): logs from pool-manager excerpt: ```
[2026-03-15T12:14:02Z] WARN warmup timeout slot=7 model=redwood-ggml-7b attempt=3
[2026-03-15T12:14:03Z] ERROR handshake delay slot=9 duration_ms=42000
[2026-03-15T12:14:05Z] INFO kv-cache miss key=prefix:acct:CNT-2134
```
oscar (eng-sre): hypothesis: sudden burst of small streaming chat completions caused kv-cache coldpath amplification, warmup workers saturated, autoscaler couldn't complete handshake before more scale intents queued. leads to tail latency + p99 spikes.
matt (eng-platform): mitigation plan in order: 1) provision +2 nodes (in flight), 2) bump warmup concurrency to 6 (runtime change), 3) enable fallback routing for non-SLA, 4) temporarily increase max-batch-wait to 25ms to absorb microbursts. Applying 2 & 4 now.
priya (eng-runtime): applying runtime flags: ```
# bump warmup concurrency
./runtime-conf set dedicated-eu-west-2 warmup.concurrency=6
# tweak batching
./runtime-conf set dedicated-eu-west-2 batching.max_wait_ms=25
```
priya (eng-runtime): applied. confirming warmup workers recreated with new concurrency. monitoring warmup completion logs.
matt (eng-platform): cloud allocation succeeded — two nodes added. pool size +2. provisioning IDs: node-rt-78, node-rt-79.
danielle (oncall): routing fallback enabled for non-SLA customers. command: `routectl set-fallback /v1/generate hosted-medium --threshold 2000` — reduced incoming qps to dedicated pool by ~18% within 60s.
oscar (eng-sre): we're seeing warmup completion on node-rt-78/79. p99 dropping: now 1.1s. queue depth trending down. still seeing intermittent streaming stalls ~1-2 per minute. investigating handshake jitter.
priya (eng-runtime): found a lock contention in bootstrap path when many short-lived streams request new KV prefixes — workaround: enable prefix-shared cache for 10s for high-churn accounts. setting: `kvcache.prefetch_ttl=10s` for pool.
priya (eng-runtime): applied prefetch TTL. expecting fewer cold misses.
nisha (support): CS reports that CNT-2134 sees improved behavior; they confirm streaming resumed with occasional hiccups. CNT-7189 still seeing occasional stalls (reporting resumed).
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation progress: p95=220ms, p99=330ms, in-flight queue=1.2k. Warmup failures dropped from 14 -> 1.
oscar (eng-sre): assigning long-form postmortem to eng-runtime + eng-platform. immediate actions to capture: autoscaler handshake timing, warmup concurrency defaults, kv-cache coldpath mitigations, routing fallback thresholds.
danielle (oncall): handoff: i'm handing over to priya for runbook follow-up and to matt for provisioning follow-ups. next oncall in 2h: alice (eng-sre). @alice you're tagged for watch. please ack.
priya (eng-runtime): ack. i'll own the post-incident checklist and create an eval job to reproduce burst pattern.
matt (eng-platform): ack, will add autoscaler telemetry to the runbook dashboards so handshake latencies are visible to oncall.
nisha (support): CS will follow up with impacted customers with summary & mitigation steps. prepping message for CNT-2134/CNT-7189/CNT-9001.
oscar (eng-sre): final status: library of mitigations applied, p99 returned to SLO, queued items drained, customer impact limited to degraded streaming for ~9 minutes. recommending temporary config changes be reverted after 24h and a gradual rollout of improved autoscaler handshake.
incident-bot: :lock: Incident transitioned to RESOLVED (mitigations in place). open tasks: (1) postmortem (eng-runtime) (2) autoscaler improvements (eng-platform) (3) kv-cache prefetch validation (runtime) (4) update runbook with fallback thresholds (eng-sre).
danielle (oncall): closing watch. adding notes to pager duty entry. thanks all — excellent quick coordination. :thumbsup:
priya (eng-runtime): creating postmortem doc and linking alerts/dashboards. will include reproduce script and perf traces.
matt (eng-platform): will schedule a follow-up sync with infra to discuss reserved capacity buffer policy.
nisha (support): CS follow-ups queued.
oscar (eng-sre): closing thread, marking as handoff->postmortem. good job everyone. :party_parrot:
